exposure: Type of 75g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) curve (flat, normal glucose tolerance, or gestational diabetes)
outcome: Maternal characteristics (age, height, weight, pre-pregnancy BMI, obesity rate)
cohort: 8,810 pregnant singleton women who underwent a 75 g oral glucose tolerance test between 24(0) and 28(6) weeks for universal screening of gestational diabetes.
finding: A 75 g flat OGTT curve, as defined, does not represent an abnormal maternal phenotype nor portend an adverse perinatal outcome.
mod_finding: Women with a flat OGTT curve had a higher vaginal delivery rate and a lower primary cesarean rate compared to women with normal glucose tolerance or gestational diabetes.
